title: Persuasion
author: Jane Austen
review:
Persuasion is such a wonderful novel. I first tried reading this when I was 14 but ended up dropping it because it just didn't hit the same as Pride and Prejudice.
But honestly, reading it again now as a 30-year-old woman? It made me see everything I completely missed back then. It really does take going through some life, love, and loss to truly feel Anne Elliot's story.
This has officially become my favorite Jane Austen novel. It's funny how some books just wait for you to grow into them.
